summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed by The Charles Schwab Corporation for a $1 billion offering of 4.603% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2029. The notes are senior unsecured obligations, offered at par, with an underwriting discount of 0.150% to yield net proceeds of $998.5 million. Interest is fixed at 4.603% until July 2028, then floats at compounded SOFR plus 0.622%. The issuer may redeem the notes at its option. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No M&A, restructuring, or strategic event is involved. The offering is underwritten by Citigroup and Goldman Sachs.
